items.zh: 一段截然不同的历史时期会浮现在脑海。
items.en: A different historical period comes to mind.

items.zh: 老一辈的人生与岁月，正悄然消逝，无人记录。
items.en: The world of aging parents threatens to vanish unrecorded.

items.zh: 校门口，妈妈往她包里塞了一副手套和一条羊毛围巾。
items.en: At the school gate, the mother packed a pair of gloves and a woolen scarf into her daughter’s schoolbag.

items.zh: 这款基于中国古典小说的游戏让许多外国玩家感受到了东方魅力。
items.en: The game based on classical Chinese novels has exposed many foreign players to the charm of the East.
